description: Werewolves work together to kill all the village. They choose a player to kill every night, and they pretend to be villagers during the day.
This role has no superpowers, sleeping all night and only votes during the day.
The protector chooses a player to protect from the werewolves every night. He can protect himself, and he cannot protect the same player twice in a row.
The witch has two potions: one that can heal the werewolves' target, the other that can kill any player.
